messages:
maria: Heads-up: CrimsonSec external pen-test scheduled Tue 2026-06-02 09:00 PT. Need final staging ops + evidence upload plan.

jamal: Copy. Is scope still staging + read-only logs + auth flows only?

maria: Yes. Staging only, read-only copies of auth & audit logs, KMS proxy on (no production key decrypt). Assessor gets ephemeral role `pt-assessor` with S3 upload + CloudWatch read.

alex: RBAC suggestion:
- Role: pt-assessor
- Allowed: CloudWatchRead, S3:GetObject/PutObject to arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence-staging/*
- Explicit deny: kms:Decrypt on prod keys

toni: Can we increase APM sampling and capture prefix/KV cache traces for suspicious flows?

jamal: We can bump TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE to 0.25 in staging for 48h. Watch cost.

maria: Also need audit export to S3 daily and tag events with `pt:external`. Can infra flip that tag quickly?

kevin: Yes. I'll add a tagger lambda to add pt:external and forward to Splunk. Need staging bucket creds for presigned uploads.

maria: Use bucket `redwood-pt-evidence-staging`. Assessor upload example:
```
aws s3 cp findings.json s3://redwood-pt-evidence-staging/Assessors/CrimsonSec/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control --profile pt-assessor
```
Presign helper (2h expiry):
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence-staging/Assessors/CrimsonSec/findings.json --expires-in 7200
```

jamal: KMS plan: create mock alias `alias/pt-staging-kms` that allows Encrypt only. We'll run a proxy that issues ephemeral wrapping keys so assessors can upload encrypted blobs without Decrypt on prod.

alex: One more compliance item: mask full prompt payloads. Set PROMPT_MASK_LEVEL=partial and redact PII at ingestion.

toni: Need snapshot of role bindings and audit export before the access window for retest proof.

kevin: I'll run `aws iam generate-credential-report` and store to `s3://redwood-pt-evidence-staging/ops-reports/cred-report.csv` before 08:50 PT.

maria: Remediation flow: create ticket in PT-Remediate board with triage label + severity. Assign owner, 7-day SLA to fix or schedule rollback. Retest slots: Fri/Sat next week 10:00-12:00 PT.

jamal: For retest include repro steps, logs snapshot id, and exact commit/tag rolled to staging/prod.

maria: Action items:
- kevin: create bucket + presign policy (due EOD today)
- alex: set PROMPT_MASK_LEVEL and bump trace sampling flag (due EOD today)
- jamal: create pt-assessor role + attach policies (due EOD today)
- toni: prepare test prompts + repro guide for assessors (due Mon)

deploy-bot: ticket PT-4829 created for assessor access & staging bucket perms :clipboard:

incident-bot: pre-test checklist reminder scheduled 2026-06-02T08:45:00Z

kevin: I'll post presigned URL template once the bucket/policy is live.

alex: Will add redaction middleware at ingestion and post snippet here.

toni: Repro guide in progress, will link tracker.

maria: We'll run a dry-run Monday 16:00 PT with CrimsonSec to validate uploads, role swap, and evidencing. Add blockers by EOD or we go green.

kevin: Dry-run confirmed. :thumbsup:
